scripts.dev:worker: pnpm --dir .. exec turbo run build --filter='...@skillplane/app' && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc --port 5173 --persist-to ../.data/wrangler/app
scripts.dev:worker:auth: pnpm --dir .. exec turbo run build --filter='...@skillplane/app' && wrangler dev --config wrangler.auth.jsonc --port 5173 --persist-to ../.data/wrangler/app-auth
scripts.deploy:check: wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --dry-run --outdir dist-worker/local && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.auth.jsonc --dry-run --outdir dist-worker/auth
